bullet_points: Load the observed map, ground-truth CMB map, kSZ truth map, and halo catalog.
Verify pixel indexing and map dimensions.
Print and verify the RMS values of all loaded maps against expected values (60, 57, 0.14, 20 μK).
Print summary statistics (min, max, mean) of the halo catalog arrays (mass, tau, v_los, delta_T_ksz_uK).
Calculate the beam function B(ℓ) for the 1.4 arcmin FWHM Gaussian beam.
Compute the power spectra Cℓ^CMB and Cℓ^noise and save them to disk.
Construct the Wiener filter W(ℓ) = (Cℓ^CMB * B(ℓ)^2) / (Cℓ^CMB * B(ℓ)^2 + Cℓ^noise) to recover the CMB signal.
Apply the filter to the observed map to produce a cleaned map and compute the residual map (observed - filtered CMB).
Apply the same filter to the ksz_map_truth.npy and compute the signal transfer function as the ratio of aperture-summed filtered kSZ signal to aperture-summed true kSZ signal at halo positions.
Save the residual map and the transfer function to disk.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Wiener Filter Construction and Transfer Function

bullet_points: Extract both single-pixel and aperture-summed (1.5x beam FWHM) temperature values at halo locations from the residual map and the kSZ truth map.
Compare the two extraction methods to validate the optimal aperture radius by maximizing the recovered signal-to-noise.
Save the extracted photometry values for each halo to disk.
Divide the 5,000 halos into ten equal-width bins based on log10(M500/M☉).
Compute and save the mean and standard error of the true delta_T_ksz_uK values within each mass bin.
Generate stacked "stamp" images of the temperature residuals for each mass bin.
Save the stacked stamps and bin statistics to disk.
Compute the estimator τ̂ for each mass bin using the velocity-weighted cross-correlation.
Apply the transfer function to correct for signal attenuation.
Perform a null test by shuffling peculiar velocities (500 iterations) and re-running the estimator.
Compute the standard pairwise kSZ estimator as a cross-check.
Save the final τ̂ values, bootstrap distributions (500 iterations per bin), and null test results to disk.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Optical Depth Estimation and Null Tests

bullet_points: Perform linear regression in log-log space to determine the τ-M scaling relation.
Compare results against the theoretical τ ∝ M^(2/3) law.
Calculate SNR for each mass bin and compare against the "ideal" (kSZ truth) and "noise-limited" (CMB-subtracted) baselines.
Generate a multi-panel figure showing the τ-M relation, SNR per bin, and null test results.
Synthesize findings, interpreting the effectiveness of Wiener-filtered CMB subtraction and the recovered τ-M slope.
Report numerical values for: scaling relation slope/normalization, transfer function correction factors, null test significance, pairwise kSZ estimator amplitude, and SNR per bin.
Write the full Results section of the report, ensuring all quantitative findings and plot interpretations are included for the paper writer.
